name: Re-login { data }
purpose: Logs the current file in again with an account name and password received as JSON in the script parameter, without a dialog. Called by Karbon at start-up for the dev file.
open_question: secret: step 5 receives the account name and password in the script parameter. Re-login across files is a FileMaker mechanism; confirm how the target authenticates instead.

name: Trigger: OnFirstWindowOpen
purpose: File-open trigger of the dev file: contains only explanatory comments and a disabled Adjust Window step, so it does nothing.

name: Trigger: OnCloseLastWindow
purpose: File-close trigger of the dev file: when the file is not hosted, sets multi-user hidden, goes to the Splash layout, hides the toolbars and menu bar and resets the window size. FileMaker window chrome only.

name: Save As Clone ( Path )
purpose: Saves a clone (no records) of the current file to the folder given as parameter. Developer utility.

name: Use Local Data File
purpose: Sets $$UseOpenDatFile and runs the on-first-window-open script; used to start the file against a local data file.
callers: none found (may be called by name)

name: Commander
purpose: Developer command dispatcher: opens Manage Database, Script Workspace or Manage Layouts, brings the window front or hides it, resets an account password, deletes an account or deactivates an account. The version of this script in the Build file reads the command from the script parameter; here that step is disabled.
